 News › News News › Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 Released for Class 10, 12: Check download links, correction dates … Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027 Released for Class 10, 12: Check download links, correction dates and important details
 Ashita Kashyap Updated: Nov 1, 2026, 12:02 IST Bihar Board dummy admit card 2027 released for Class 10, 12 The Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released admit cards for students in Class 10 and 12 for annual examinations in 2027. Students are advised to go through every detail on their admit cards.
 If there are any errors students must report them to their school principals before the deadline. 
 As per the board’s announcement on October 31 the correction window will be open from November 1 to 7, 2026. During this time students can get their admit card details corrected. The corrections will be submitted online only through the respective schools. Therefore, students should not try to make changes. It is important that schools handle all correction requests. 
 Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027: Important dates 
 Event 
 Date 
 Dummy admit card release
 October 31, 2026

 Class 10 and 12 board examinations

 The above table shows important events and dates to apply. 
 The board has released separate portals for Matric and Intermediate students and these are as follows: 
 Class 10 (Matric): https://exam.biharboardonline.org/ 
 Class 12 (Intermediate): https://intermediate.biharboardonline.com/ 
 How to Download Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027? 
 The steps to access provisional admit cards is as follows: 
 Visit the official BSEB portal for Class 10 or Class 12.
 Find the link for the Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027.
 Enter the required login details, such as registration number and date of birth, wherever requested.
 Submit the details to view the admit card.
 Download the document and take a printout.
 Check all personal and examination-related information carefully.
 Students who cannot access their admit cards should contact their school authorities for assistance. 
 The details students should check on Dummy Admit Cards
 The dummy admit card is prepared using information submitted during the registration and examination application process. 
 Therefore, even a small spelling mistake or incorrect subject entry should be brought to the school's attention.
 Students should verify the following details:
 Full name and spelling
 Father's and mother's names
 Date of birth
 Registration number
 Photograph and signature
 School name and school code
 Examination name and class
 Subject names and subject codes
 Other personal and academic details
 It is important to note, BSEB has clarified that a complete change in the student's name or the names of their father or mother will not be permitted. Students should therefore carefully check these particulars and consult their school if they notice discrepancies.
 Bihar Board Dummy Admit Card 2027: How to correct mistakes?
 Students cannot independently make corrections through the download portal. They must inform their school headmaster or principal, who will submit the eligible correction requests through the board's online system.
 The process is as follows:
 Download the dummy admit card.
 Identify the incorrect information.
 Inform the school principal or headmaster immediately.
 Provide supporting documents wherever required.
 Ask the school authorities to submit the correction online.
 Verify that the requested correction has been completed.
 Students should not wait until November 7 to report errors, as schools also need time to process correction requests.
 What is the difference between a Dummy Admit Card and a final Admit Card?
 A dummy admit card is a provisional document issued before the final examination hall ticket. 
 Its purpose is to allow students to verify the information recorded with the board and correct eligible errors. 
 The final admit card is the official document required to appear for the board examination. It contains the candidate's examination details, including the roll number and examination centre. 
 Therefore, downloading the dummy admit card does not mean that a student can use it to enter the examination hall.
 When will Bihar Board conduct the 2027 Class 10 and 12 exams?
 The BSEB Class 10 and Class 12 annual examinations are expected to take place in February 2027. Therefore, students should not assume dates for individual subjects until the official subject-wise timetable is released. 
 The board will share details about the final admit cards and the full examination schedule on its official websites. Students must take the dummy admit card verification process seriously. Fixing any mistakes, at this stage can save them from problems later during the final admit card and examination process.
